DICETHESPIRE-STICKY_FINGERS.title: Sticky Fingers
DICETHESPIRE-STICKY_HAND.description: Card rewards contain an additional off-color card.
DICETHESPIRE-STICKY_HAND.title: Sticky Hand
DICETHESPIRE-TINY_TREBUCHET.description: Pips now deal [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
DICETHESPIRE-TINY_TREBUCHET.flavor:
I should ask the Inventor if she can increase it's accuracy.
...On second thought, she'd probably just break it.
DICETHESPIRE-TINY_TREBUCHET.title: Tiny Trebuchet
DICETHESPIRE-TINY_TREBUCHET.pipDescripti: Deal {Damage} damage to a random enemy.
DICETHESPIRE-BAG_OF_TRICKS.description: At the start of each combat, add [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random off-class cards into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It is free to play this turn.
DICETHESPIRE-BAG_OF_TRICKS.title: Bag Of Tricks
DICETHESPIRE-POCKET_DICE.description: At the start of combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Pips[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DICETHESPIRE-POCKET_DICE.flavor: While 6s are definitely more useful, never underestimate the value of a couple spare 1s.
DICETHESPIRE-POCKET_DICE.title: Pocket Dice
DICETHESPIRE-LOUD_BIRDS_MIXTAPE.descript: The first time you apply a unique debuff each combat, gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
DICETHESPIRE-LOUD_BIRDS_MIXTAPE.flavor: While all the CAW-ing hardly counts as music, I'll admit it's incredibly motivating.
DICETHESPIRE-LOUD_BIRDS_MIXTAPE.title: Loud Bird's Mixtape
DICETHESPIRE-WINDOW_PUNCH.description: The Count of the first [gold]Countdown[/gold] card you draw each turn is reduced by 1 until played.
DICETHESPIRE-WINDOW_PUNCH.flavor:
A must-have tool for making a quick exit.
...Mind the glass.
DICETHESPIRE-WINDOW_PUNCH.title: Window Punch
DICETHESPIRE-COUNTERFEIT_COIN_PURSE.desc: Once at each shop, you may steal something you can't afford.
DICETHESPIRE-COUNTERFEIT_COIN_PURSE.flav: It doesn't need to look perfect. It just needs to convince them long enough for you to leave.
